设计意图： Crossover: primary mechanism from volume-adjusted price range with residual volatility regime gate (parent 1). Lightweight modifier from downside volatility asymmetry factor (parent 2): replaced simple rolling mean (window=10) with exponential moving average (span=10) to reduce noise and improve signal consistency, targeting moderate ICIR. Preserves the core price-volume coherence and resvol gate.

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

-(raw = (high - low) * (volume / <EMA_volume(20)>); smoothed with ewm_mean(10); then scale by 1.2 when resvol_high > 0, else 0.8; then cs_rank.)
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（DSL 算子链）

  1. 步骤1：col('factor') → 取指定列字段（如 col('close') → 收盘价序列）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 high_low：high - low
  2. 计算 volume_ema：volume.ewm(span=20, adjust=False).mean()
  3. 计算 volume_ratio：volume / volume_ema
  4. 计算 volume_ratio：volume_ratio
  5. 计算 raw_signal：high_low * volume_ratio
  6. 计算 smoothed_signal：raw_signal.ewm(span=10, adjust=False).mean()
  7. 计算 resvol_high：style_gate_resvol_high
  8. 计算 factor：np.where(resvol_high > 0, smoothed_signal * 1.2, smoothed_signal * 0.8)
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。
